notes: Note: To better find the files to download, select "Change View: Tree". This dataset is associated with the paper "Benchmarking pig detection and tracking under diverse and challenging conditions" published in Computers and Electronics in Agriculture. The dataset contains: 2931 images from conventional pig farming with object detection annotations in yolo and coco format with predefined training, validation and test splits A JSON file that, for each annotated image, specifies whether it is randomly selected or challenging, as defined in the corresponding paper. Trained model weights for pig detection A thorough explanation of all files contained in this data repository can be found in ReadMe.txt. The github repository associated with this dataset can be found at https://github.com/jonaden94/PigBench. It includes commands to automatically download the files from this data repository that are required for model training, evaluation, and inference.
